EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7 My Reference No. : 3/5/DO/2014/454. Land Ministry Reference No.: 4/3/9/2014/IR/346. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
